scope: Reviewable non-executable release plan, not a deployment executor or acceptance result

prerequisites.required: Whole D1 package release acceptance or separately reviewed/tested split release
Installed DB03/DB04 handoffs and final cross-workstream release reconciliation
Workstream security/integration review; DB02 ADR-006 does not waive it

recovery_policy.precommit_failure: Prove full data/catalog/role/ACL/history rollback at early/middle/final checkpoints
recovery_policy.postcommit_incident: Stop affected writers; preserve history; separately reviewed forward fix or tested restore with explicit recovery point
